It does **not** define      on-chain multi-sig, dispute windows, challenge games, timeout fallbacks, or emergency unwind. Protocol risk includes:      compromised reporter key (arbitrary signed results), reporter downtime (markets may not resolve until      posting resumes), and insider misbehavior. getDataSource(bytes32).details: Intentional gas/indexing tradeoff: bind integrity to `getResolveDataSourceHash` + events, not on-chain strings.      Callers auditing settlements SHOULD retain off-chain preimage↔hash mappings; the chain alone cannot resurrect an unknown URI from a bare hash.

getResult(bytes32).details: When unresolved, engine must not treat as final; once resolved, value reflects reporter-attested path only.

getDataSource(bytes32).notice: Full URI is not stored on-chain; may return empty. Index `ResultPosted` + backend for audit.

getResolveObservedAt(bytes32).notice: Wall-clock style observation time committed in the signed resolve payload.
